unreleased: Add knowledge base pages: write Markdown notes on a collection or integration, with an integration's knowledge base automatically merging in every one of its collections' pages, always up to date.
Add integrations: combine collections and standalone API documents into a team-only integration, with a merged, de-duplicated document view tagged by source.
Add collections: group API documents into a collection, share it publicly or within your team, and subscribe to be notified when any of its documents gets a new version.
Add automatic recheck scheduler: API documents with a daily/weekly/monthly recheck period are now checked periodically in the background, not just on demand.
Add subscriptions and notifications: subscribe to any visible API document to get notified of new versions, view your notifications with unread counts, and mark them as read.
Add API document registry: register third-party API docs by URL or file upload, browse version history, trigger manual rechecks/re-uploads, and share publicly or within your team.
Add teams: create/rename teams, manage membership, and invite members by email with an accept link.
